name: flybnb-battery-male
annotations: Janelia FlyEM MaleCNS v1.0 body annotations (minconf 0.5), CC-BY 4.0
note: indices are rows of the payload's neuron table (the same for the >=5 and the >=2 synapse export); ids are MaleCNS body ids. Brain and ventral nerve cord.

stimuli.name: sound
stimuli.rule: class == 'mechanosensory' and subclass == 'auditory' (Johnston's organ A and B). In this release the right antenna's auditory neurons are nearly disconnected (see outgoing_synapses_by_side): this is a LEFT-ear stimulus, and the battery has no separate sound_left

stimuli.name: sound_gate
stimuli.rule: sound plus the AN02A001 neurons (the male type matched to FlyWire's AN_multi_8, the gate of the female battery). Not purely sensory

stimuli.name: taste_leg
stimuli.rule: class == 'gustatory' and subclass == 'leg bristle' (the nerve cord is part of this connectome)
